settings.apiKeyRoundRobinHint: Separate multiple API keys with spaces to rotate them automatically in a round-robin order.

tooltips.apiKey: Paste the API key issued by your provider. Multiple keys separated by spaces will be rotated automatically to minimize throttling.
tooltips.modelName: Enter the exact model ID (for example, gemini-1.5-pro-latest). It must match the ID shown in your provider console.
tooltips.requestsPerMinute: Match this value with your account's requests-per-minute (RPM) limit so the app slows down before the API returns 429 errors.
tooltips.maxOutputTokens: Upper limit for how many tokens the model can generate per response. Higher values allow longer outputs but consume more quota.
tooltips.maxConcurrentRequests: Limits how many translation requests run in parallel.
tooltips.baseUrl: Enter the base URL for the OpenAI-compatible server (e.g., http://localhost:8001/v1).
tooltips.thinkingMode: Use Gemini's thinking (chain-of-thought) mode for harder tasks. It improves accuracy but costs extra tokens and response time.
tooltips.setThinkingBudget: Enable this switch to cap how many thinking tokens Gemini may spend so you can manage cost per request.
tooltips.thinkingBudget: Token budget for the reasoning step. Leave it at 0 to let the provider decide automatically, or set a value to enforce a cap.
tooltips.cacheTag: Cache tags group translations by project. Using the same tag lets the app return previous results instantly without calling the API again.
tooltips.examplePresetSelector: Example presets inject a few real source/target samples so the model learns tone, terminology, and formatting before translation.
tooltips.promptPresetSelector: Prompt presets are reusable instructions that describe tone, formatting rules, and JSON contracts for the AI.
tooltips.examplePresetEditor: Add at least two examples for every language pair you support. The translator reuses them as few-shot demonstrations.
tooltips.promptPresetType: Choose TEXT for document translation prompts or IMAGE for prompts optimized for screenshot/image flows.
tooltips.promptPresetContent: Write the exact prompt delivered to the AI. Use helpers such as {{content}}, {{language::source}}, or {{language::target}} to inject runtime values.
tooltips.cacheManager: The cache stores every translated segment locally. Review or delete entries here instead of paying for the same translation again.
